subject: dsa
title: Insert Interval
summary: The list is already sorted and non-overlapping, so place the new interval by start time and merge any neighbors it touches. Overlapping intervals collapse into one that spans the min start and max end.
problem: Insert a new interval into a sorted list of non-overlapping intervals, merging overlaps so the result stays sorted and non-overlapping.

steps.caption: Start from the sorted, non-overlapping list [1,3], [6,9].
Insert the new interval [2,5]. Slot it in by start time, then check which existing intervals it overlaps.
[1,3] and [2,5] overlap, since 2 <= 3. Merge them into [1,5] using the smaller start and larger end.
Compare the merged [1,5] with [6,9]: 6 > 5, so they don't overlap and [6,9] is left untouched.
Nothing else overlaps. The result is [1,5], [6,9].
